## Constraints

### Must

- Preserve all six product routes and the original application fields.
- Keep application preview messaging honest until a submission API exists.
- Support keyboard focus and one-column mobile layouts.

### Avoid

- Decorative card grids, glass effects, and placeholder actions.
- Unlabeled form controls.

## Decisions

- Newsreader headlines and DM Sans interface text; warm paper, deep green, pale sage, and thin dividers.
- Photo-led introductions and dark featured panels for key decisions.
- Accessible Radix workshop tabs and manual story controls; generated people are labeled illustrative.
- Touch-sized carousel controls and a selectable story index avoid repeating full quotes.
- University marks and firm SVG wordmarks use spacious bordered grids adapted from the 21st Logo Grid Cloud, with a visible institution non-endorsement note.
- Locally stored stock photographs have source credits.
- The favicon, header, footer, and touch icon share a compact B and slash mark in the site's night green, paper, and sage palette.
